_comment: The smart-ra files this overlay is built from, pinned by commit and sha256 (AGENTS.md: every dependency pinned and verified). build.py fetches them at this commit and refuses any file whose sha256 differs. Bumping smart-ra is an edit here plus `python3 tools/archimate/build.py`.

model.why: The DPI-H RA ArchiMate model (version 0.3.0-draft.1, with the Integrated View of Figs. 3.2 and 3.5) that the overlay is drawn on; every RA element keeps its Archi id, so its IRI is the one smart-ra publishes.

addViews.why: smart-ra's own script for adding elements, relationships and views to an Archi model from a spec, without rewriting what is there; reused rather than copied.
